llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed Notion-backed memory and journaling tool; it has meaningful data-access risk, but the inspected behavior fits its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: It uses Notion credentials and reads selected local workspace memory/dream files for recall staging, which is sensitive but disclosed and purpose-aligned.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package dependencies or installer-side persistence were found; it requires Node and a separate notion-api-automation skill or NOTIONCTL_PATH.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: It gives persona/continuity workflow instructions and limited subagent delegation guidance, but does not contain hidden role overrides, safety bypasses, or unrelated execution instructions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: It can create/patch Notion databases, write Notion pages, migrate emotion-scale fields, and write local receipt/mirror files; these actions are documented and user/configuration directed, not stealthy.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill's Notion memory, emotion/state ticks, journaling, recall, schema setup, local mirrors, and ambient recall all align with its stated continuity and subjective-memory purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you want the agent to store and recall personal continuity data in Notion. Use a dedicated Notion integration limited to the intended databases/pages, verify the DB IDs and cron/heartbeat configuration, and set SIS_AMBIENT_RECALL=0 if you do not want ambient recall staging.
llm.findings:
[TP4] expected: Notion token use and remote read/write behavior are explicitly described in SKILL.md metadata, the Notion Auth section, and README setup/usage; users should still provide a least-privilege Notion integration.
[AE1] expected: The referenced scripts were present locally and inspected; the partial-inspection warning was not supported as evasion in this workspace.
[PE3] unexpected: The cited '.env' signal came from test code constructing environment variables for subprocess fixtures, not from production code reading credential files.
[RA1] unexpected: The cited 'Update skill' text is an error hint for an incompatible notionctl dependency, not code that modifies the skill itself.
[SDI-1] expected: The Notion bridge exposes broad helper functions, but shipped entrypoints use them for documented setup, schema patching, page writes, bounded queries, and migrations tied to the skill purpose.
[AIG SARIF] expected: The supplied SARIF contained no results; manual inspection likewise found no remote payload retrieval, obfuscated execution, destructive behavior, or hidden persistence.
